findings.title: Empty-expression filter runs before interpolation
findings.body: In runSplitQuery targets are filtered by `query.expr` truthiness on lines 296-298 and only then mapped through `datasource.applyTemplateVariables`. A raw expr like `$var` is truthy so it passes the filter, but after interpolation it can become empty string. That empty query is then classified by isLogsQuery/metric path, partitioned, and executed via datasource.runQuery instead of being skipped like other empty queries. The filter must run after interpolation.

findings.title: Shard path interpolates twice via nested runSplitQuery
findings.body: runShardSplitQuery now maps every target through datasource.applyTemplateVariables, then builds subRequest objects and calls runSplitQuery which maps the same targets through applyTemplateVariables again in querySplitting.ts. The updated test in shardQuerySplitting.test.ts asserts applyTemplateVariables is called 5 times for a single target, proving per-shard-group re-interpolation. This is redundant template work scaling with shard count and makes correctness depend on applyTemplateVariables being perfectly idempotent for expr and step.
